name: The Outbreak: Day Zero
source:
The Outbreak is an apocalyptic horror kinetic novel series about a recovering heroin addict and a medical student who fight to survive after a deadly virus is unleashed in the hospital of a major city.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141216091527/http://theoutbreakseries.wordpress.com/about/]official site[/url]]
translation:
《爆发》是一部世界末日恐怖动态小说系列，讲述了一名正在康复的海洛因成瘾者和一名医学生在一座大城市的医院释放致命病毒后为生存而奋斗的故事。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141216091527/http://theoutbreakseries.wordpress.com/about/]官方网站[/url]]
